items.computation: The letter is dated Friday 27.03.2026 and sets a 10-Werktage period 'nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens' (from the letter's own date), with Werktage defined as Monday-Saturday excluding statutory holidays. Under §187(1) BGB the day of the event (27.03.2026) is not counted, so counting starts 28.03.2026. Counting 10 working days (Mon-Sat, NW holidays excluded) from 27.03.2026 lands on Friday 10.04.2026 (Good Friday 03.04.2026 is a Friday in NW - not a holiday in 2026 wait, checked via tool which already accounts for holidays). The resulting date, Friday 10.04.2026, is itself a working day, so no further shift under §193 BGB is needed.
